segments.title: Morning Call
segments.notes: Opened with the bunker siren test. 47 survivors tuned in by estimate.

segments.title: Weather Report
segments.notes: the_meteorologist provided data. Surface temp -12C, wind NW 22km/h, visibility 200m. Ashfall light.

segments.title: Ration Announcement
segments.notes: the_quartermaster approved the script. Rice reduction from 200g to 180g. No complaints on air.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played the Bach cello suite from the vinyl archive. Side B. Three survivors requested it yesterday.

segments.title: Security Notice
segments.notes: the_general reviewed. Perimeter sweep at 1400. Surface teams avoid sector 7.

overrun_cause: the_meteorologist added an unscheduled note about atmospheric particulate density. Let it run.
signal_quality: Clear. Minor static on the 40m band from the storm front.

segments.title: Evening Address
segments.notes: Short. People are tired after the water pump repair.

segments.title: Water Update
segments.notes: the_plumber provided technical details. Gravity-feed backup online. Primary pump offline for seal replacement.

segments.title: Missing Persons
segments.notes: Read three names submitted by survivors. Anyone with information to contact the_general. This segment is always the hardest.

segments.title: Children's Corner
segments.notes: the_teacher let the children pick a song. They chose the one about the fish. It is not a real song. They made it up.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Signed off at 1824. On time.

signal_quality: Good. Two listeners reported feedback on the shortwave. Adjusted gain.

segments.title: Emergency Opening
segments.notes: Delayed broadcast. Radiation storm detected at 0530. the_general ordered immediate airtime.

segments.title: Storm Bulletin
segments.notes: the_hazmat_tech read the dosimetry data. External dose rate climbing. All surface operations suspended. Shelter in place.

segments.title: Safety Reminders
segments.notes: Seal checks on blast doors. Wet cloth over ventilation gaps. Do not open water cistern until all-clear.

segments.title: Roll Call
segments.notes: Each zone leader confirmed their area sealed. Generator zone reported a draft from the cable conduit. the_electrician dispatched.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Told people to stay calm, stay inside, stay together. Signed off.

signal_quality: Poor. Storm interference on all bands. Estimated 60 percent of bunker heard the full broadcast.

segments.title: Midday Check-in
segments.notes: Post-storm all-clear issued at 1100. First broadcast since the storm.

segments.title: Storm After-Action
segments.notes: the_general provided summary. Peak external dose 85 microSv/h at hour 6. Duration 14 hours. No internal contamination detected.

segments.title: Damage Report
segments.notes: the_architect walked through the bunker on mic. Minor seepage in corridor C. Air filter degraded 15 percent. No structural damage.

segments.title: Memorial
segments.notes: the_priest read a brief passage. No names. Just a moment of silence for anyone the storm took outside.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played the Chopin nocturne. Someone left a note requesting it. No signature.

signal_quality: Excellent. Post-storm atmospheric clarity. Best reception in weeks.

segments.title: Morning Call
segments.notes: Standard opening. Mentioned it is day 53. Someone counted.

segments.title: Greenhouse Report
segments.notes: the_botanist came on herself. First mushroom harvest. 2.3 kg of oyster mushrooms. She sounded almost happy.

segments.title: Trade Notice
segments.notes: the_quartermaster announced the barter session for day 55. Accepted items listed. No currency, as always.

segments.title: Birth Announcement
segments.notes: the_surgeon confirmed a successful delivery. Mother and child stable. First bunker-born child. Named Asha. The bunker needed that.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played something upbeat. A pre-war pop song. People were humming it in the corridor after.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Signed off. Good morning.

signal_quality: Good. Minor interference from the generator cycle. the_electrician adjusting.

segments.title: Evening Address
segments.notes: Delayed. the_general was still briefing me on the Kilo-1 situation when airtime hit.

segments.title: New Arrival Policy
segments.notes: the_general explained the intake criteria without naming the refused applicant. the_therapist requested airtime to present the counter-argument. I let both sides run.

segments.title: Open Forum
segments.notes: Survivors called in with opinions. Mostly angry. Some at the_general, some at the_therapist. One woman said she would take in a refugee herself if the bunker would allow it. I did not identify her.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Told people the argument is not over and that is okay. Signed off late.

overrun_cause: The open forum ran long. It needed to. This is democracy in a concrete box.
signal_quality: Fair. The long-wire antenna picked up a distant station on the 40m band during the open forum. Could not identify the source. Let it play.

segments.title: Morning Call
segments.notes: Quiet morning. People are settling into the new shift rotation.

segments.title: Shift Schedule
segments.notes: the_quartermaster read the new rotation. Generator team 0400-1200. Greenhouse 0600-1400. Medical 0800-1600. Surface patrol 0500-1100.

segments.title: Maintenance Alert
segments.notes: the_plumber announced water pipe inspection in corridor B. Brief disruption expected between 1000 and 1200.

segments.title: Education Block
segments.notes: the_teacher introduced the new curriculum. Reading group at 1500. Math at 1600. She asked parents to send children with paper and the charcoal pencils.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played the folk album from the archive. Side A. The one with the song about the river.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Standard sign-off.

signal_quality: Clear. The new antenna from the_mechanic is performing well. 10dB gain as promised.

segments.title: Midday Special
segments.notes: Special broadcast. the_priest requested airtime for a eulogy.

segments.title: Eulogy for Oscar-1
segments.notes: the_priest spoke for eight minutes. the_undertaker provided the biographical details. Oscar-1 died on day 64 from radiation exposure sustained before arrival. 4.1 Sv. He knew. He came here anyway.

segments.title: Burial Notice
segments.notes: the_undertaker announced the interment at 1400 in the ash dune cemetery. All welcome. Surface-rated personnel only.

segments.title: Moment of Silence
segments.notes: Two minutes of dead air. The longest two minutes of my career behind this microphone.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played the Adagio from Albinoni. It was not the right choice. It was too beautiful for this place. But it was the only thing that fit.

signal_quality: Clear. Broadcast was received by at least two external listeners. the_radio_host logged anomalous signal bounce. Possible atmospheric ducting.

segments.title: Morning Call
segments.notes: Five minutes late. the_radio_host overslept. First time this has happened. Noted.

segments.title: Expedition Debrief
segments.notes: the_courier returned from the frozen river route. Reported ice thickness stable. Barge location accessible. Recovered 40 kg of supplies. the_general reviewed on air.

segments.title: Supply Update
segments.notes: the_quartermaster confirmed the new inventory. Rice reserves at 62 days. Medical supplies at 45 days. Fuel at 30 days. The numbers are getting shorter.

segments.title: Court Announcement
segments.notes: the_general announced the next court session for day 72. Two cases: unauthorised access to the medical bay and a dispute over ration allocation.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Signed off. Mentioned that the radio_host would try to be on time tomorrow.

overrun_cause: Short broadcast. The news was mostly numbers today.
signal_quality: Fair. Intermittent static from the storm front to the east.

segments.title: Evening Address
segments.notes: the_radio_host was joined by the_chef for a special segment.

segments.title: Recipe of the Week
segments.notes: the_chef demonstrated mushroom and barley soup. Live. He described each step while the_chef actually made it in the kitchen. The sounds of cooking on radio. Someone laughed.

segments.title: Taste Test
segments.notes: Three volunteers came to the studio to taste. Their reactions were genuine. the_botanist said the mushrooms tasted like the forest floor. the_mechanic said it tasted like not starving.

segments.title: Community Requests
segments.notes: Read requests from the suggestion box. Someone wants a broadcast about insects. Someone else wants the weather read in a different accent.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: the_chef said goodnight. First time a co-host has signed off. It felt right.

overrun_cause: None. Best broadcast of the month.
signal_quality: Good. The cooking sounds transmitted clearly. the_radio_host moved the kitchen mic closer.

segments.title: Morning Call
segments.notes: Standard. Mentioned day 79. Seven days until the next court session.

segments.title: Medical Update
segments.notes: the_surgeon reported the dysentery cluster is contained. Seven cases, all recovering. Water treatment verified. No new cases in 48 hours.

segments.title: Quarantine Lift
segments.notes: the_general announced the kitchen quarantine is lifted. the_chef is back. Full meal service resumes today.

segments.title: Lost Signal Report
segments.notes: the_radio_host reported picking up a fragment of a broadcast on 7.2 MHz at 0340. Voice, male, speaking English. Could not resolve the content. Logged frequency and time for analysis.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played the jazz album. the_courier requested it. Said it reminded him of running.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Standard sign-off.

signal_quality: Good. The 7.2 MHz fragment was logged. the_radio_host will monitor the frequency at the same time tomorrow.

segments.title: Midday Check-in
segments.notes: Quiet day. No emergencies. A quiet day is a good day.

segments.title: Council Decision
segments.notes: the_general announced the council's decision on the Delta-1 emissary trade proposal. Accepted with modifications. Salt trade with the Freeholders begins day 90.

segments.title: Trade Protocol
segments.notes: the_quartermaster detailed the exchange rates. Salt for dried fish. Two kilograms salt per kilogram fish. the_chef will inspect all food imports.

segments.title: Children's Segment
segments.notes: the_teacher brought three students to read their essays. Topic: what I would do if the sky came back. The answers were varied and heartbreaking.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Signed off. The essays stayed with me.

signal_quality: Clear. The children's voices transmitted well. the_teacher used the close mic.

segments.title: Morning Call
segments.notes: Day 88. the_radio_host is tired. The signal log is getting long.

segments.title: Generator Report
segments.notes: the_electrician reported the Variac bypass is holding. Fuel consumption down 8 percent. Estimated fuel reserves now at 45 days instead of 30. The bypass bought time.

segments.title: Surface Conditions
segments.notes: the_meteorologist reported temperature rising to -8C. Ice melt beginning on the frozen river. Barge access window closing.

segments.title: Security Alert
segments.notes: the_general reported the generator sabotage investigation is ongoing. No suspects. Increased lock changes. All personnel to report unusual activity.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played the string quartet. Slow movement. It sounded like grief.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Signed off.

signal_quality: Fair. The generator sabotage alert was broadcast on the_general's instruction. Tone was measured but firm.

segments.title: Evening Address
segments.notes: Delayed. the_general and the_therapist were in session. The bunker can wait fifteen minutes.

segments.title: Court Verdicts
segments.notes: the_general read the two verdicts from day 90. Case 1: unauthorised medical bay access, reprimand and one week kitchen duty. Case 2: ration dispute, mediated by the_therapist, both parties accepted terms.

segments.title: Therapist Note
segments.notes: the_therapist spoke briefly about the mediation process. Invited anyone with an unresolved conflict to come forward. Said the room is always open.

segments.title: Anniversary Notice
segments.notes: Day 95 will mark 95 days since the event. the_priest is planning a memorial service. Details to follow.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Signed off. Ninety-five days. It feels like a year. It feels like nothing.

overrun_cause: Short broadcast. The verdicts were brief. The therapist note was the longest segment.
signal_quality: Good. the_therapist's voice was calm on air. People responded well.

segments.title: Anniversary Special
segments.notes: Ninety-five days since the event. the_radio_host did not prepare remarks. Just started talking.

segments.title: Roll Call of the Dead
segments.notes: the_undertaker read every name. Twenty-three bunker dead. Fourteen arrivals who did not survive intake. Three expedition casualties. Forty names. The bunker was very quiet.

segments.title: Survivor Testimonies
segments.notes: Eight survivors spoke. Each had two minutes. the_widow spoke about her husband. the_courier spoke about the road. the_botanist spoke about the first seed that grew. the_child_soldier spoke about his squad. He is twelve.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played the entire Barber Adagio. All eight minutes. Then the Bach again. Then silence for two minutes.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: the_radio_host said: we are still here. Signed off. Turned off the mic. Did not turn off the radio.

overrun_cause: None. This was not a normal broadcast.
signal_quality: Clear. The broadcast was heard by at least three external listeners based on signal bounce. No response from any of them. The silence was also transmitted.

segments.title: Morning Call
segments.notes: Day 98. The day after the anniversary. People are quiet this morning.

segments.title: Mental Health Notice
segments.notes: the_therapist requested airtime. Announced open-door sessions for the next three days. No appointment needed. Said the anniversary can bring things up. She was right.

segments.title: Greenhouse Update
segments.notes: the_botanist reported the potato sprouts from the expedition source. First green in the greenhouse that is not a leafy vegetable. People need to see something grow.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played something gentle. Acoustic guitar. Pre-war. The artist is unknown. The recording has surface noise. It sounded like rain.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Standard sign-off. the_radio_host added: take care of each other today.

signal_quality: Good. the_therapist's notice was important. Six survivors attended the open-door session on day 98.

segments.title: Evening Address
segments.notes: Standard opening. Mentioned the successful trade with the Shallows Market caravan. First external trade contact.

segments.title: Trade Report
segments.notes: the_quartermaster detailed the exchange. Dried mushrooms and herbs for smoked fish and salt. the_chef inspected the fish. Acceptable quality. First fresh protein from outside in 102 days.

segments.title: Expedition Planning
segments.notes: the_general announced the next surface expedition. Target: the seed vault. Team: the_courier, the_hunter, the_hazmat_tech. Departure day 105.

segments.title: Community Notice
segments.notes: the_teacher announced the children's art exhibition in corridor A. Day 104. All survivors invited. The children have been working on something.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played the folk album again. Side B this time. The song about coming home. No one in this bunker has a home to come back to. But the song is still good.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Signed off.

signal_quality: Excellent. The long-wire antenna is performing beyond expectations.

segments.title: Morning Call
segments.notes: Day 106. Expedition team departed yesterday. the_radio_host is monitoring frequencies for their check-in.

segments.title: Expedition Status
segments.notes: No contact since departure. This is normal for the seed vault route. Expected check-in is day 107 at 1200. If no contact by day 108, the_general will dispatch a search team.

segments.title: Bunker Status
segments.notes: the_architect reported the corridor C seepage has been sealed. the_plumber confirmed water quality tests passed. All systems nominal.

segments.title: Personal Note
segments.notes: the_radio_host broke format. Said he is worried about the_courier. She has been gone before but never this long without a check-in. Asked listeners to keep their radios on.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played the entire acoustic guitar album. All of it. the_radio_host did not speak over it.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Signed off. Kept the receiver on.

signal_quality: Fair. the_radio_host is scanning all bands for the expedition team's handheld. No contact.

segments.title: Emergency Opening
segments.notes: Early broadcast. the_courier checked in at 1145. Handheld signal weak but readable. Team is at the seed vault. All three accounted for.

segments.title: Expedition Update
segments.notes: the_courier reported: seed vault accessible. Cryo-units partially intact. Recovered 14 viable seed ampoules. the_hazmat_tech reports external dose at the vault is 28 microSv/h. Manageable with time limits.

segments.title: Return Timeline
segments.notes: Team departing seed vault at 1200. Estimated return to bunker day 109 by 1600. the_general has the airlock team standing by.

segments.title: Celebration Notice
segments.notes: the_chef announced a special meal when the team returns. He has been saving something. Would not say what on air.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: the_radio_host signed off. His hands were shaking. He did not say why on air.

overrun_cause: None. Short emergency broadcast. Good news is easy to broadcast quickly.
signal_quality: Poor then good. the_courier's handheld was barely readable. The bunker transmitter is strong.

segments.title: Evening Address
segments.notes: Day 112. The bunker is in a good place tonight. the_radio_host can feel it.

segments.title: Seed Vault Report
segments.notes: the_botanist presented the full inventory. 14 ampoules: turnip, barley, potato, two varieties of bean, cabbage, carrot, onion, radish, pea, lentil, squash, and one unidentified. She was crying. She was not hiding it.

segments.title: Planting Schedule
segments.notes: the_botanist and the_quartermaster coordinated on air. First plantings day 115. Greenhouse capacity doubled. The bunker might eat real food by day 150.

segments.title: Trade Expansion
segments.notes: the_general announced a second trade contact. Juliet-1, the journalist, has provided coordinates for 12 settlements. the_general is evaluating which are viable trade partners.

segments.title: Music Block
segments.notes: Played the upbeat folk album. Both sides. the_chef sang along in the kitchen. the_radio_host let it carry.

segments.title: Close
segments.notes: Signed off. Day 112. We are still here. We are growing things. That is enough for tonight.

signal_quality: Excellent. The long-wire antenna and the clear post-storm air are giving the best reception since day 1.
